create_class_State: create the _State base class used to hold composable API state for PyTorch modules
insert_module_state: insert a _State object into the module state mapping for a given PyTorch nn.Module
get_module_state: get the _State associated with a PyTorch nn.Module or return None if not found
build_module_state_mapping: build a global module-to-state mapping dictionary for composable distributed APIs
test_module_state_lookup: test retrieving _State from a module via the composable state lookup API
